title: On weighted partial triangulations of convex polygons
summary: We study the problem of sampling weighted partial triangulations of a convex polygon with $n+2$ sides. We consider the distribution $π_{n,λ}$ under which each partial triangulation $σ$ is assigned probability proportional to $λ^{|σ|}$, where $λ>0$ is a model parameter and $|σ| \in \{0,\dots,n-1\}$ denotes the number of diagonals in $σ$. This model belongs to a broad class of weighted geometric partition problems that include lattice triangulations and dyadic tilings, and is closely related to several classical combinatorial structures, including the full triangulations of a convex polygon…
